en.probe.missing: OpenCode is not installed on this worker yet. It is installed automatically.
en.probe.install_failed: Installing OpenCode on this worker did not finish: {reason}. It is tried again in {minutes} min.
en.probe.broken: OpenCode at {path} does not start: {reason}. Reinstall it, or remove it so it is installed automatically.
en.probe.could_not_run: Checking OpenCode on this worker did not finish: {reason}.
en.install.not_found_after: npm finished, but OpenCode is not where it was installed
en.install.unreachable: this worker can't reach {host} ({code}), so npm cannot download OpenCode. Check the worker's network connection, and its proxy if it needs one: npm reads HTTPS_PROXY and its own `proxy` setting
en.install.untrusted_certificate: this worker reaches {host} only through a certificate npm does not trust ({code}), as a firewall that inspects traffic presents. Give npm that certificate with `npm config set cafile <file>` on the worker
en.log.own: OpenCode {version} runs as the person installed it, at {path}.
en.log.passed_over_older: The OpenCode at {path} is {version}, older than {minimum}, so it is not used.
en.log.passed_over_newer_major: The OpenCode at {path} is {version}, a major version after {minimum} that Frontier has not been tested with, so it is not used.
en.log.passed_over_unknown: The OpenCode at {path} does not say its version, so it is not used.
en.log.passed_over_broken: The OpenCode at {path} does not start ({reason}), so it is not used.
en.launch.missing: OpenCode is not installed on this worker yet. It is installed automatically, then the session starts.
en.status.about: OpenCode works at once with its free models, with nothing to sign in to. To use your own model provider, such as Anthropic, OpenAI or a local model, sign in to it once on each worker in OpenCode itself. Frontier installs OpenCode on every worker and never holds your sign-in.
en.status.not_reported_reason: This worker has not reported on OpenCode yet.
en.status.no_workers: OpenCode runs on workers. Pair a worker from the Workers view, and it shows here.
en.status.signin_heading: Adding a model provider on a worker
en.status.signin_step_terminal: Open a terminal on the worker from the Workers view.
en.status.signin_step_done: Choose the provider and sign in. Its models show here within a few minutes.
en.status.signin_alternative: A provider's key in the worker's environment, such as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, works too once the worker is restarted.
